description: This Java class 'AccrualAccountingDataValidator' provides validation logic for accrual accounting data, specifically for loan periodic accrual data, including JSON parsing, parameter validation, and date checks.

classes.name: AccrualAccountingDataValidator
classes.description: A final class annotated as a Spring component, responsible for validating accrual accounting JSON data, especially for loan periodic accruals.

methods.name: validateLoanPeriodicAccrualData
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for loan periodic accrual data, checking for unsupported parameters, parsing date fields, and ensuring the date is before the current business date.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any validation errors collected during the validation process.
